title: materialised in-tree symlink (no gap, link path published as a regular file)
shortcut: Like CTL-C1-3, but for every in-tree symlink the receipt drops the unpublished-entry gap, removes the unpublished_entries metadata and publishes a regular file at the link path carrying the target's sha256 and size. The published regular-file set still contains every oracle file.
